journey.title: A path that did not start in code.
journey.description: Six years of high-performance sport before the first line of code, and a year spent entering large codebases written by other people. None of it was left behind. It only changed field.

projects.title: Products with people on the other side.
projects.description: Three of them are live right now, serving Brazil, Portugal and Ireland. The code is closed, so instead of a repository link the cards carry the numbers you can check and the product itself.

contact.title: Let us build something.
